design: Acquire publicly purchasable documented flavors, three distinct manufacturing lots per SKU; analyze non-nicotine reference materials before any regulated sample work
endpoints: Targeted flavor quantitation; aw; KF; pH; chromatographic degradation products
caveat: Avoid comparing products of different dose, manufacturing history, or storage conditions; do not extrapolate across product lines

design: Chemically profile matched products labeled mint, wintergreen, cooling, and unflavored; pre-register selected analytes
factors: WS-3; WS-23; menthol; methyl salicylate; sweeteners
endpoints: Targeted GC–MS/LC–MS with standards, blanks, recovery, reporting limits
caveat: Brand and flavor labels do not determine full chemical composition

design: Nicotine-free MCC × HPC × flavor identity with RH and light control; blocked DOE with independent batches
factors: MCC grade; binder; menthol/vanillin/control; RH; storage time
endpoints: Flavor retention, water sorption, wetting, surface accessibility, color
caveat: Do not infer nicotine release from non-nicotine mockups

study: Separation of filler and fabric effects
design: Matched fill material in 2–3 documented nonwoven fabrics at controlled moisture and area
endpoints: Wicking/permeability, extractables, seal integrity, moisture uptake
caveat: Avoid confusing fabric pore size with MCC particle porosity

design: Prospective matched data across same material preparations and batches
factors: aw, KF, PAI, retention, cohesion, impurity fraction
endpoints: Nested CV, lot holdout, calibration curves, missing-data reporting
caveat: Never combine unrelated commercial datasets into complete artificial product records
